meta.name: aed:aurora-bg
meta.description: Animated aurora gradient backgrounds. When the addon is enabled, `data-auto-scope` selects the elements that get the effect (typically the home hero + CTA sections). When disabled, the entire effect disappears site-wide — the meta tag isn't emitted, JS never stamps attributes, and any in-DOM `data-aed-aurora` markers become inert CSS selectors with nothing to paint on.

data-auto-scope.description: CSS selector for elements to auto-decorate. E.g., '.hero, .cta-section' to light up every hero + CTA.

data-auto-intensity.description: Default intensity for auto-scoped elements. Overridden per-element by data-aed-aurora-intensity.

data-auto-static.description: Disable animation on auto-scoped elements (still renders the gradient).

data-animation-duration-ms.description: Global drift animation duration in ms. Writes --aed-aurora-duration on <html>.

data-orb-blur-px.description: Global blur radius in px for the orb clouds. Writes --aed-aurora-blur on <html>.

data-opacity.description: Base opacity for the orb layers. Writes --aed-aurora-opacity on <html>. Per-element intensity variants (subtle/bold) override this.

data-hue-shift-deg.description: Hue rotation applied to the orb layers in degrees. 0 = brand palette as-is; ±30 for a vibe shift. Writes --aed-aurora-hue on <html>.

data.description: Per-element aurora background opt-in. Useful when not using auto-scope.

data-aed-aurora-bg.description: Set on <html> to skip the entire aurora effect on this page even if the addon is otherwise enabled.
